contexts.text: They covered the nakedness of their father () = that they excused these things. AC 9960:16.
The seers are said to be covered (), when they know nothing of truth, and see nothing of truth.
Moses covered his faces () = that the interiors were protected.
Covered the land of Egypt (). To cover, being said of the natural mind, = that it was filled with falsities, and thence reasonings, (frogs).
Covered the chariots and horsemen () = that their own falsities hid them.
The sea covered them () = that all falsity thronged on them.
Covered the camp () = that it infilled all the Natural.
The wings covered their bodies () = that the Divine truth covered the Divine good from which it proceeds.
Covering the mercy-seat with their wings () = spiritual things covering in.
As the Natural covers and closes what is above, it is called a covering.
To cover the flesh of nakedness () = lest the interiors of love appear, which are filthy and infernal. AC 9960:14.
The reason they were to cover it (), was that all those places in Hell are covered and closed...
To cover, is predicated of truths. Explained. AE 717:9. Occurs.
